ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (gray/white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) central and proximal regions; high-intensity (gray/white) distal lobes containing dense, non-contiguous dark-pixel circular spots concentrated near the margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center with an internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys (serrations) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Descending convex curve following the edge from the lateral tips toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of discrete, circular dark-pixel clusters (5-12 pixels in diameter) localized on the light-toned distal regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonal dark linear disruptions visible against the light-toned background on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural irregularities and jagged topographical deviations along the trailing edge consistent with prior physical disruption.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast dark-spot pigmentation patterns strictly localized to the distal white-pigmented areas of the fluke lobes.
